_doc: RELENTLESS_BUILD_BOXRUN_AT_FINISH (redesign_final.md WP-07; owner 2026-11-06: 'the checker should run the code to check it rather than philosophize'). relentless_boxrun.py runs the contract's proof as written in the Marker's box: at finish (outside store.lock, re-fenced after) and on the builder's `boxrun` verb.
_mode: off | shadow | enforce. shadow: finish runs and prints the box output, refuses nothing; every run is a line of <store>/boxrun.jsonl. enforce: a red proof refuses finish with the box output on the builder's stdout. Flip to enforce once the shadow log's reds read as real (relentless_boxrun.sli).
_stores: finish runs the box only for these store roots: the selftests' temporary stores finish without one (relentless_boxrun's own selftest passes its own config).
_timeout_s: a run past this is box_error (timed out), never red: the builder's own Bash call around finish must outlive it
